selection: First processed response-cohort source ID, first two occupied tiles, up to eight requests per tile; no outcome or prediction selection.
image_transform: Level-0 read, white alpha composite, RGB, bilinear resize to512; lossless PNG of actual inference RGB pixels.
bbox_convention: Inclusive mask pixel extents, int(pixel/512*1000), xyxy.
coordinates: slide_x_um and slide_y_um in micrometres; read rectangle in native level-0 pixels.
interpretation: Functional inference example. Archived outputs are model predictions, NOT measured expression.
